title: Celina Jaitly Marks Second Diwali Away From Sons With Emotional Message
excerpt: The actor shared an Instagram post for Winston, Viraaj and Arthur on November 8, saying she missed them and that her home and love were always open to them.
body:
• Celina Jaitly marked Diwali on November 8 with an Instagram post for her sons Winston, Viraaj and Arthur, saying it was her second Diwali without them.
  • The actor said her sons are living in Austria with their father, Peter Haag, while she and Haag are undergoing a divorce and legal battle across Austria and India, according to the reports.
  • In the post, she said her greatest fear was that her sons might forget her love, and she assured them that her home and arms were always open to them.
  • She also told her sons that nothing could erase the life they shared or the love she had given them.

Celina Jaitly marked Diwali away from her three sons this year, sharing an emotional Instagram post for Winston, Viraaj and Arthur on November 8, 2026. According to BollywoodShaadis, she shared a photograph featuring herself with her sons alongside a note saying she missed them, and that this was her second Diwali without her children. Fanziz reported the same details, saying the three boys live in Austria with their father, Peter Haag, and that this was her second Diwali without them.

BollywoodShaadis reported that Jaitly described her sons as the lights of her life and said her brightest Diwali was only with them. In the note, she recalled her pregnancies and the food she had made for her children. “I remember those first little kicks, a gift on the eve of my birthday. I remember every samosa, every pani puri, every cake, every cinnamon roll, every ladi pav I made for you with so much love,” she wrote, according to the report.

The post also addressed the family's separation directly. BollywoodShaadis reported that she said it broke her heart to think that her sons had to pick sides because of her divorce. She said she had been left with no option but to protect whatever little she had left for their future, and she said she would always remain grateful to Haag for bringing the children into the world with her, according to the same report.

“My greatest fear is that you may forget your mother’s love amid everything you are being told. My prayer is that the pain & everything that tore our family apart never take away the kindness & light in your innocent hearts,” she wrote, according to BollywoodShaadis.

Fanziz reported a further assurance from the post: “Mummy has never left you. Nothing can EVER erase the life we shared or the love I have given you.” BollywoodShaadis reported that she called her sons her home, said they gave her strength every day, and assured them that nothing could erase the life they shared, the love she had given them, or the future they could have together. She closed that part of the message, according to BollywoodShaadis, by writing: “I miss you, my boys. My home, my arms & my love are always open to you.”

BollywoodShaadis identified Haag as Jaitly's estranged husband and reported that Winston, Viraaj and Arthur are living with him in Austria, while the couple are undergoing a divorce and legal battle across Austria and India. The report also noted that Jaitly is a mother of four children. Her son Shamsher, Arthur's twin, died shortly after birth in 2017 and, according to BollywoodShaadis, could not survive because of a congenital heart condition.

Fanziz also reported that Jaitly is returning to Hindi cinema with Sister Nivedita. No further details about that return were given in the reports read for this story, and neither report carried a response from Haag to the Diwali post.
